description.zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用[AddFaceUserGroup](~~288341~~)接口添加用户时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致。
description.en: The business isolation ID, used to isolate data between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. This value must be consistent with the **IsolationId** set when adding a user by calling the [AddFaceUserGroup](~~288341~~) operation.

description.zh: 用户组ID。请传入在调用[AddFaceUserGroup](~~288341~~)接口添加用户组后，获取并保存到本地的用户组ID。
description.en: The user group ID. Set this parameter to the user group ID that was obtained and saved locally after you called the [AddFaceUserGroup](~~288341~~) operation to add a user group.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为100。
    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits
The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for calling this operation is 100.
    > RAM users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
